title: High-touch intake capacity simulator and roadmap triage
creator: Marina Alvarez
description: Problem: High-touch enterprise accounts frequently request roadmap commitments and escalations that require cross-functional effort. Current intake is ad hoc, leading to overcommitment, missed SLAs, and unclear trade-offs between revenue/strategic value and engineering capacity. Goal: Build a lightweight intake+triage system plus a capacity simulator that lets PMs and GTM leaders model the near-term impact of accepting top-account asks on roadmap delivery and a consistent SLA-backed response funnel for escalations. Deliverables: 1) Scoring rubric for top-account asks (strategic weight, ARR at risk, engineering points, compliance/risk, time-to-value). 2) A capacity simulator (spreadsheet + small web UI prototype) that simulates the next 12-week roadmap with accepted asks and shows displacement impact on planned initiatives. 3) A triage and routing playbook: defined bands (Immediate Escalation, High-touch Review, Standard Intake) with SLAs and required artifacts. 4) Dashboards and a triage view in the Console / Intake sheet to track commitments, owners, and rollback triggers.
acceptance_criteria: Scoring rubric documented and vetted by Sales Eng, Solutions, and Security
Simulator accepts inputs for: engineering points, expected ARR impact, risk score, required compliance effort, and desired delivery window
Simulator outputs: projected weekly capacity utilization, two-week delivery displacement map, and list of initiatives at risk with % delay estimate
Triage playbook defines three bands with SLA targets: Response(24h/48h/5d), Decision(5d/10d/30d), Commitment window and fallback policy
Pilot with three strategic accounts run and results logged to project dashboard (before/after displacement)
proposal: Phase 1 (3 weeks): Build the scoring rubric and an initial Google Sheets simulator populated with historical cycle velocity and current committed work. Phase 2 (4 weeks): Iterate simulator into a small lightweight web prototype (React + serverless function) that can import CSV of current roadmap items and compute displacement. Phase 3 (ongoing): Integrate triage state and accepted asks into the roadmap tracker and surface alerts in Console. Key heuristics: weight = 0.5*ARR_signal + 0.3*strategic_alignment + 0.2*escalation_severity; cost_impact = engineering_points + compliance_points*1.5. Use a conservative smoothing window for velocity to avoid optimistic commits. Include a manual override path for executive signoff with recorded trade-off rationale.
